title: Strict integral quotient-stalk reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extension E of Q_l, finite field datum D with algebraic closure k of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], l distinct from its characteristic, and a scheme T with l invertible. Use the actual quotient towers and integral module stalks of [lem-trf-bounded-quotient-stalk-realization] and the geometric germs of [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. For every point v:Spec(k) to T and alpha in Aut(k), there exists a natural integral-linear isomorphism R(v,alpha) between the strict quotient-stalk tower functors at v and at Spec(alpha) followed by v. At level n and degree i its underlying function is the published A_(n+1)-linear reparametrization, and on each germ [U,u,x] it sends u to Spec(alpha) followed by u and leaves x fixed. Its published Roos map satisfies both product-projection coordinate equations. There are corresponding isomorphisms on the upper and bounded good-truncation towers commuting with both boundary arrows, for every p,q. The strict tower maps satisfy the opposite composition law R(v,alpha) followed by R(v alpha,beta)=R(v,alpha.trans beta), the inverse law given by alpha inverse at v alpha, and the unit law. No descended derived isomorphism or point-section comparison is asserted.

proof.text: For any completed integral module sheaf, reindex its additive pointed-neighbourhood diagram by precomposition of its lift with Spec(alpha), keeping the site object, every site arrow, and every section fixed. The functor is an equivalence with inverse obtained from alpha inverse, with the canonical endpoint identifications. The colimit map is therefore an additive isomorphism. The constant integral scalar germ is fixed by reindexing: compute its product with a section at a common refinement; reindexing changes only the lift. Thus these are integral-linear maps. The same computation with a module-sheaf morphism gives naturality on all completed integral module sheaves.

proof.text: Whisker this natural stalk isomorphism with the actual quotient tower functor, after extending it termwise to complexes. Naturality for differentials and for quotient transitions gives a strict natural tower isomorphism R. Its finite-level underlying function equals the published finite coefficient reparametrization because both functions send every colimit coprojection at N to the coprojection at the reindexed N; restriction of scalar action leaves the underlying additive diagram unchanged. This also proves the explicit germ formula.

proof.text: Put Q=product R_n and D=1-s. Naturality for transitions gives D Q=Q D-prime by projection to each factor. Hence the diagonal (Q,Q) is a map of cocones: d(Qb,Qa)=(-dQb-D-prime Qa,dQa)=(Q(-db-Da),Qda). It is the published integralOperationsRoosMap because that construction is the shifted mapping-cone map of the product square. The first projection commutes with Q and so does the degree-minus-one second projection. Composing each with the nth product projection gives both required equations.

proof.text: Whisker the same integral module stalk natural isomorphism with the actual upper truncation tower and with the bounded tower. Naturality with respect to the upper kernel inclusion and lower cokernel projection gives both squares. This argument works without bounds on the terms, and for p=q or p>q as well, since it uses the boundary maps of the given functors.

proof.text: Two successive reindexings send (U,u,x) to (U,Spec(beta) followed by Spec(alpha) followed by u,x). Spec reverses composition, so this is the reindexing for alpha.trans beta. Coprojections jointly determine additive maps, and hence the natural tower maps. The identity fixes every coprojection. The inverse reindexing cancels the original, yielding the inverse law. These are heterogeneous equalities only because the point endpoints are canonically equal.

theorem trfStrictQuotientStalkReindexing
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : T, Invertible (l : T.residueField x)] :
    ∃ (R : ∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k),
        trfQuotientStalkTower l E v ≅ trfQuotientStalkTower l E
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v)),
      (∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k)
        (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
        HEq ((((R v α).hom.app P).app (op n)).f i).hom.toFun
          ((proEtaleStalkReparam (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) v α).hom.app
            (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E T n).obj P).X i)).hom.toFun) ∧
      (∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k)
        (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
        (N : ProEtaleGeometricNeighbourhood v)
        (x : ((((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P).obj (op n)).X i).val.obj (op N.right)),
        (((R v α).hom.app P).app (op n)).f i
            ((colimit.ι ((proEtaleGeometricNeighbourhoodForget v).op ⋙
              ((((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P).obj (op n)).X i).val.presheaf) (op N)) x) =
          (colimit.ι ((proEtaleGeometricNeighbourhoodForget
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v)).op ⋙
                ((((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P).obj (op n)).X i).val.presheaf)
            (op ((proEtaleStalkNeighbourhoodReparam v α).obj N))) x) ∧
      (∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k)
        (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ),
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          integralOperationsRoosMap ((R v α).hom.app P) ≫
              CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
                (scalarRoosBoundary ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E _).obj P)) ≫
              Pi.π (fun m ↦ ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E _).obj P).obj (op m)) n =
            CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
                (scalarRoosBoundary ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E v).obj P)) ≫
              Pi.π (fun m ↦ ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E v).obj P).obj (op m)) n ≫
              ((R v α).hom.app P).app (op n)) ∧
        (∀ (i j : ℤ) (h : i + -1 = j) (n : ℕ),
          (integralOperationsRoosMap ((R v α).hom.app P)).f i ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
                (scalarRoosBoundary ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E _).obj P))).v i j h ≫
              (Pi.π (fun m ↦ ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E _).obj P).obj (op m)) n).f j =
            (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
                (scalarRoosBoundary ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E v).obj P))).v i j h ≫
              (Pi.π (fun m ↦ ((trfQuotientStalkTower l E v).obj P).obj (op m)) n).f j ≫
              (((R v α).hom.app P).app (op n)).f j)) ∧
      (∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k)
        (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) (p q : ℤ),
        ∃ (U : trfUpperTower ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) q ⋙
              (integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E v).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
            trfUpperTower ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) q ⋙
              (integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
          (B : trfBoundedTower ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) p q ⋙
              (integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E v).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
            trfBoundedTower ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) p q ⋙
              (integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)),
          U.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight
              (trfUpperArrow ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) q)
              ((integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) =
            Functor.whiskerRight (trfUpperArrow ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) q)
              ((integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E v).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ≫
                (R v α).hom.app P ∧
          U.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight
              (trfLowerArrow ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) p q)
              ((integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) =
            Functor.whiskerRight (trfLowerArrow ((trfQuotientTower l E T).obj P) p q)
              ((integralCoefficientModuleStalkFunctor l E v).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ≫
                B.hom) ∧
      (∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α β : D.k ≃+* D.k),
        HEq ((R v α).hom ≫
            (R (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v) β).hom)
          (R v (α.trans β)).hom) ∧
      (∀ (v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T) (α : D.k ≃+* D.k),
        HEq (R (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom) ≫ v) α.symm).hom
          (R v α).inv) ∧
      (∀ v : Spec (.of D.k) ⟶ T,
        HEq (R v (RingEquiv.refl D.k)).hom (𝟙 (trfQuotientStalkTower l E v)))
